title: Jagged Lamb Skewers with Smoky Thai Sauce
description: Grilled lamb skewers marinated in a smoky Thai-inspired sauce, perfect for a flavorful and spicy meal.

ingredients.name: Jagged bamboo skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before grilling

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use 2-3 cloves if you like garlic

ingredients.name: Chili flakes
ingredients.notes: Adjust the level of heat to your taste

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine fish sauce, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, chili flakes, and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
Thread lamb pieces onto jagged bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb skewers with the smoky Thai sauce, making sure they are evenly coated.
Grill the lamb skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the lamb skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and additional smoky Thai sauce if desired.
Serve with steamed vegetables or rice for a complete meal.
